integrity: Explicit analytical proof and an extracted standalone exact-rational finite checker; verified finite instances do not establish universal assertions.
scientific_limitations: Real, unweighted finite clique bouquets with one common hub and snowflake exponent from zero to one; independently weighted and multi-hub graphs are not covered. Earlier equivalent Euclidean distance-matrix or minimum-enclosing-sphere results remain possible and independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact Hilbert distortion and dimension transition for snowflaked clique bouquets
